description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called FragmentRetainInstance, demonstrating how to use fragments to retain state across activity instances. It contains the main activity class, a nested UiFragment class handling UI interactions, and a nested RetainedFragment class implementing a retained fragment that manages a background thread to update a progress bar.

classes.name: FragmentRetainInstance
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating fragment retention and UI updating with a background thread.

classes.name: UiFragment
classes.description: A fragment handling UI setup and interactions, including a button to restart a background task.

classes.name: RetainedFragment
classes.description: A retained fragment managing a background thread that updates a progress bar to simulate ongoing work, surviving configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the UI fragment if no saved instance state exists.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's UI layout and sets up the button click listener.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the retained fragment responsible for background work.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the retained fragment, sets it to be retained, and starts its worker thread.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves the progress bar view and signals the background thread to start working.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Signals the background thread to stop upon fragment destruction.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the fragment is detached from its activity, stopping the background thread.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Method for UI to restart the background progress thread.
